items.name: ascii
items.summary: Returns the ASCII code point of the first character of string.

items.name: base64
items.summary: Encodes the input binary `bin` into a base64 string.

items.name: char
items.summary: Returns the ASCII character having the binary equivalent to col. If col is larger than 256 the result is equivalent to char(col % 256).

items.name: concat
items.summary: Concatenates multiple input strings into a single string. Returns NULL if any input is NULL.

items.name: concat_ws
items.signature: fn concat_ws(sep: datafusion_expr::Expr, args: datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_expr::Expr
items.summary: Concatenates strings with separator. Supports arrays. Null values are skipped.

items.name: elt
items.signature: fn elt(select_col: datafusion_expr::Expr, arg1: datafusion_expr::Expr, arg2: datafusion_expr::Expr, argn: datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_expr::Expr
items.summary: Returns the n-th input (1-indexed), e.g. returns 2nd input when n is 2. The function returns NULL if the index is 0 or exceeds the length of the array.

items.name: format_string
items.signature: fn format_string(strfmt: datafusion_expr::Expr, args: datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_expr::Expr
items.summary: Returns a formatted string from printf-style format strings.

items.name: ilike
items.signature: fn ilike(str: datafusion_expr::Expr, pattern: datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_expr::Expr
items.summary: Returns true if str matches pattern (case insensitive).

items.name: is_valid_utf8
items.summary: Returns true if str is a valid UTF-8 string, otherwise returns false

items.name: length
items.summary: Returns the character length of string data or number of bytes of binary data. The length of string data includes the trailing spaces. The length of binary data includes binary zeros.

items.name: like
items.signature: fn like(str: datafusion_expr::Expr, pattern: datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_expr::Expr
items.summary: Returns true if str matches pattern (case sensitive).

items.name: luhn_check
items.summary: Returns whether the input string of digits is valid according to the Luhn algorithm.

items.name: make_valid_utf8
items.summary: Returns the original string if str is a valid UTF-8 string, otherwise returns a new string whose invalid UTF8 byte sequences are replaced using the UNICODE replacement character U+FFFD.

items.name: quote
items.summary: Returns str enclosed by single quotes and each instance of single quote in it is preceded by a backslash

items.name: soundex
items.summary: Returns Soundex code of the string.

items.name: space
items.summary: Returns a string consisting of n spaces.

items.name: substring
items.signature: fn substring(str: datafusion_expr::Expr, pos: datafusion_expr::Expr, length: datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_expr::Expr
items.summary: Returns the substring from string `str` starting at position `pos` with length `length.

items.name: unbase64
items.summary: Decodes the input string `str` from a base64 string into binary data.
